cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Taj card offering privileges at Taj Hotels, including complimentary stays, dining benefits, and milestone rewards for luxury travelers.

mileStoneItems.benefits: Taj Epicure Membership.NeuPass Taj InnerCircle Platinum Tier membership.Get two nights breakfast-inclusive stays at hotels across India and a one-night stay at Taj Palaces, Also get a voucher for an extra one-night stay at Taj Palaces with every new or renewed card.Offer valid until 31 March 2026
